facts.text: The tagline dares you to "Watch Tonya do a sunset strip." Subtle it is not.
Monique Parent studied acting at the Beverly Hills Playhouse under Jeffrey Tambor and Milton Katselas before heading to the Strip.
Monique Parent has studied ballet and jazz dance since age three. Every cast member here plays "Self," so that's her real dance training on display.
Monique Parent moved to Los Angeles in 1990. Her first movie, Secret Games, came out in 1991, and this one followed two years later.
Stephanie Hudson went on to Beach Babes 2: Cave Girl Island, Femalien, and Sandy Hook Lingerie Party Massacre. Titles don't get more video-store than that.
Director Edward Holzman later made Forbidden Games (1995), an erotic thriller about a psychic detective and two cyberpunk dominatrixes.
Edward Holzman's Hollywood Sins (2000) was released by Playboy Home Video. It's a story about a talent agent who loses it all.
Lisa Throw's later credits include Shandra: The Jungle Girl, Kama Sutra, and Lady Chatterley's Stories. She was a straight-to-video staple.
Monique Parent also appeared in Playboy's Night Dreams in 1993, the same year as this movie.
Mimi Faillace's credits include Penthouse: Ready to Ride and Playboy: Private Diaries. She worked both sides of the glossy-magazine video rivalry.
